payload.summary: Completed phase 7 (wp-integration): confirmed no sibling wp branches exist so 7.1 had nothing to merge and both full suites reproduce baseline; proved the enablement gate fails correctly on a scratch flip-and-revert of INJECTION_DEFAULT_ENABLED with the flip byte-identically reverted; confirmed contract promotion is byte-identical; remediated both drift-gate blockers this change owns (regenerated contracts-inventory.md, added the missing documentation surface to two work packages context_impact blocks); validated the change by id at the CI-pinned openspec version 1.7.0; and recorded (without executing) the gh api call needed to make the two new CI jobs required contexts.
completed_work: Task 7.1: verified no --wp-* siblings; packages/context-eval (306 passed), skills/tests/context-engineering/ (735 passed), skills/install.sh --check (exit 0)
Task 7.2: flip/run/revert mutation proof recorded at docs/evaluation/semantic-context/enablement-gate-mutation-proof.md
Task 7.3: confirmed byte-identical contract promotion and README.md row
Task 7.4: remediated both owned context-drift-gate blockers (api.contracts, context.impact)
Task 7.5: openspec validate --strict by change id at version 1.7.0, valid
Task 7.6: recorded (not executed) the gh api call for branch protection required contexts

decisions.title: 7.1 has nothing to merge
decisions.rationale: All seven packages executed sequentially on the single feature branch; git branch --list shows no --wp-* siblings, so integration reduces to re-running the full verification surface rather than a merge.

decisions.title: Mutation proof captured as a durable artifact, not just console output
decisions.rationale: Design D14 requires showing the gate fail, not just asserting it would; wrote docs/evaluation/semantic-context/enablement-gate-mutation-proof.md recording both the raw module exit code (3) and make (2, with the real code in its Error line).

decisions.title: Added documentation surface to wp-contracts and wp-scoring context_impact blocks
decisions.rationale: validate_context_impact.py flagged both as undeclared for a documentation surface implied by README.md and markdown test fixtures respectively; declaring is a one-way strict commitment so both surfaces were added rather than argued away.

next_steps: A repository admin should run the recorded gh api PATCH call to make context-eval and semantic-enablement-gate required contexts on main.
Validation should confirm the PR diff against main touches only files inside declared work-package write_allow scopes across all seven phases, not just phase 7.
